mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.name, e.email, e.role, t.team_name, d.department_name, e.position, e.title FROM employee e LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN department d ON t.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.employee_code = #{employee_code}
SELECT employee_id, employee_code, name, email, role FROM employee WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')

SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, t.team_id, t.team_name, e.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.name, e.position, e.position_level, e.title, e.manager_id FROM employee e LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN department d ON t.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY d.department_id, t.team_id, (e.title != '팀장'), e.position_level DESC, e.name

SELECT e.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.name, e.email, e.role, t.team_name, d.department_name, e.position, e.title FROM employee e LEFT JOIN team t ON e.team_id = t.team_id LEFT JOIN department d ON t.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.employee_id = (SELECT manager_id FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{empId})
SELECT remain_leave FROM employee WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId}
